purpose: Numerical and recovery control for shared gradients plus persistent server Adam; NOT predictive performance, model selection, or MIME
initialization: From scratch, same seed and 39-64-32-8 LayerNorm MLP in every case; no archived model is loaded or updated
objective: sqrt_weighted_ce with fixed_train_mean denominator from the historical training cohort; reused train-only scaling is for numerical checks only, not a new generalization experiment
reference: Centralized weighted loss accumulation over exactly the same 20 client minibatches, one Adam step AFTER accumulation; not ordinary sequential pooled minibatch Adam
sampling: Uniform with replacement within each fixed historical client assignment; 512 rows/client/step; identical schedule in all cases/arms. Per-client, per-step dropout seed replay and caller RNG preservation
clipping_order: Global norm clip after gradient aggregation, then PyTorch Adam adds coupled L2; no client clipping or local optimizer
checks: Compare raw gradients, clipped gradients, parameters, first/second Adam moments and counters at EVERY step. Require bit-exact per-arm serialized midpoint recovery and independent full-process non-timing replay
costs: Count model broadcast plus gradient upload per client per synchronized update, separately for FP32/FP64. These are payload counts, not measured network traffic or a claim of affordable full training
failure_policy: Fail closed on nonfinite values, identity/recovery/tolerance failures; preserve failed result and do not relax tolerances after observing real-data output
next: If numerical checks pass, specify the new from-scratch development boundary and bounded MIME comparison before quality training. No automatic long run, historical-test scoring, or adaptive-method search
